title: Damages
description: Damage found on the cars, with photos and repair cost

help.title: About damages
help.overview: Record each damage with photos. It is linked to the booking it happened in and to the policy that covered the car that day.

sections.title: How a damage is handled
items: Staff are notified of each new damage. A major one sets the car to Needs a check.
Send to repair creates a repair in the service log, or adds the damage to one already planned. With a ready date, the car is blocked until then.
When the repair is completed, the damage becomes Repaired. Its cost is the repair's cost.
Charge the customer of the booking (up to their excess) and note what the insurer paid; both show as recovered in Reports.
